item.text: I’ll trace the proxy address configuration and Kubernetes kubeconfig generation, record the checkpoint first, then make the focused change and run the relevant existing tests.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: Fix "'`tctl auth sign --format=kubernetes` so the kubeconfig uses the Kubernetes proxy address on port 3026, with a `ProxyConfig.KubeAddr()` helper and the required fallback to registered proxies.

Progress: Repository inspection started. No implementation changes yet.
EOF
pwd && git status --short && rg -n "type ProxyConfig|Kube'"\\.PublicAddrs|format=kubernetes|kubernetes.*kubeconfig|Kubeconfig|kubeconfig\" lib tool"
